_about: How a company core data sheet (CCDS) change maps to each region's label sections, and which catalogue change carries it. Company targets are training defaults, not regulatory deadlines.

sections.us: Section 6 Adverse Reactions (and the Medication Guide or patient information if it lists side effects)
sections.eu: SmPC section 4.8 Undesirable effects; package leaflet section 4
sections.in: Adverse reactions section of the prescribing information and package insert
sections.ca: Product monograph Part I, Adverse reactions; Part III patient medication information
sections.ch: Information for healthcare professionals, Undesirable effects; patient information
sections.who: SmPC section 4.8 Undesirable effects; patient information leaflet

kinds.label: New or strengthened warning or precaution

sections.us: Section 5 Warnings and Precautions, and Highlights
sections.ca: Product monograph, Serious warnings box (if serious) and Warnings and precautions
sections.ch: Information for healthcare professionals, Warnings and precautions
sections.jp: Package insert section 1 (warning box, if serious) and sections 8 and 9, precautions
sections.who: SmPC section 4.4 Special warnings and precautions for use

sections.jp: Package insert section 7, precautions related to dosage (section 6 if the approved dosage changes)
sections.who: SmPC section 4.2 Posology and method of administration

sections.in: Indications section (a new claim needs a new drug permission)
sections.jp: Package insert section 4, Indications (an approved matter)

sections.eu: Affected section only (usually with the next procedure)
sections.ca: Any part of the product monograph or labels
sections.ch: Any section of the information texts
sections.jp: Any section of the package insert
sections.who: Any section of the SmPC, leaflet or labels
